vendored.note: Copied verbatim from DLEAPP, which itself adapted it from Fortra impacket 0.13.1 (impacket/structure.py + impacket/ese.py, folded into one stdlib-only file with the six/logging dependencies inlined, plus a fix so an ESE 7-bit-compressed tagged column decodes instead of returning None). GLEAPP's own upstream for this file is DLEAPP, not impacket directly - re-vendor from DLEAPP if it updates this file, or re-adapt from impacket per the provenance note at the top of the file if going further upstream is ever needed. Reads Windows.edb (ESE) for the Windows Search index; see gleapp/winsearch.py.
